libraryIssues.problem: The rule's example list describes the strengthening lām (لام التقوية) only 'before the object of a participle'. The fronted-object rule likewise mentions only 'objects of participles fronted with a strengthening lām'. The lām also strengthens a finite verb weakened by its object being fronted, as in 7:154 لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ, where the ayah i‘rab says «اللام زائدة للتقوية حيث ضعف العامل بتأخره». The wording could lead authors or reviewers to think the rule does not apply there.
libraryIssues.fix: Extend the lām al-taqwiya clause in extra-particle to read: 'the strengthening lām (لام التقوية) before the object of a participle, or before an object fronted ahead of its verb (لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ 7:154)'. Make the matching addition to fronted-object.

libraryIssues.problem: No rule in libs/rules.json covers لامِ جحود (the lām after a negated كَانَ: مَا كَانَ / لَمْ يَكُنْ + لِـ + subjunctive, with an implied أَنْ). The subjunctive rule's governor list (أَنْ، لَنْ، كَيْ، إِذَنْ، lām of purpose, حَتَّىٰ، فَ/أَوْ) also leaves it out and says to pair subjunctive with a governing-particle rule. libraryIssues.fix: Add a rule such as 'lam-juhud' (لامِ جحود): 'Tag an imperfect verb carrying the lām that follows a negated كَانَ (مَا كَانَ، لَمْ يَكُنْ) and that the i‘rab calls لام الجحود. The verb is subjunctive by an implied أَنْ, the interpreted masdar is genitive and attaches to the elided khabar of كان, and the construction strengthens the negation. QAC tags this lām PRP. Also tag subjunctive.' Add to purpose-lam: 'Not for لام الجحود after a negated كان (lam-juhud), even when QAC tags it PRP.' Add 'lām al-juḥūd (implied أَنْ)' to the subjunctive rule's governor list and pairing list.
